11:  *   setMode(mode) / getMode()       — switch between 'demo' and 'hardware'

13:  *   unsubscribePunches()            — stop receiving events

55: /**
56:  * Probe whether the accelerometer hardware is available.
57:  * Strategy: attempt a real subscribeAccelerometer. If fail callback fires
58:  * or 500ms elapse with no data, mark unavailable. If data arrives, mark
59:  * available and immediately unsubscribe the probe.
60:  *
61:  * @param {Function} successCb — called with true if sensor is available
62:  * @param {Function} failCb    — called with false if sensor is unavailable
63:  */
64: function probeSensor(successCb, failCb) {
65:   if (_probing) { return; }
66:   if (!(sensor && typeof sensor.subscribeAccelerometer === 'function')) {
67:     _sensorAvailable = false;
68:     if (failCb) { failCb(false); }
69:     return;
70:   }

76:     if (!_probing) { return; }
77:     _probing = false;
78:     if (_probeTimer) { clearTimeout(_probeTimer); _probeTimer = null; }
79:     try { sensor.unsubscribeAccelerometer(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
80:     _sensorAvailable = available;

82:     else { if (failCb) { failCb(false); } }
83:   }

117:  * Subscribe to real-time punch events.
118:  * In demo mode, replays demoEvents. In hardware mode, hooks into accelerometer.

145:           }
146:         }

148:     } catch (e) {

153:     }
154:   } else {

156:   }
157: }

159: /**
160:  * Idempotent accelerometer unsubscribe.
161:  * Safe to call even if no subscription is active.
162:  */
163: function _safeUnsubscribeAccel() {
164:   try {
165:     if (sensor && typeof sensor.unsubscribeAccelerometer === 'function') {
166:       sensor.unsubscribeAccelerometer();
167:     }
168:   } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
169: }

171: /**
172:  * Reset the peak detection state machine and gravity estimate.
173:  */
174: function _resetPeakState() {
175:   _gravity = 0;
176:   _peakState = PEAK_IDLE;
177:   _peakValue = 0;
178:   _peakStartTime = 0;
179:   _lastPunchTime = 0;
180: }

182: /**
183:  * Process a single accelerometer sample from hardware.
184:  * 1. Compute magnitude.
185:  * 2. Update gravity estimate via EMA.
186:  * 3. Compute linear acceleration (magnitude minus gravity).
187:  * 4. Run peak detection state machine.
188:  * 5. On confirmed peak, emit one punch event.
189:  *
190:  * @param {Object} res — { x, y, z } from system.sensor
191:  */
192: function _onAccelerometerData(res) {
193:   if (!_punchCallback) { return; }
194: 
195:   var x = res.x || 0;
196:   var y = res.y || 0;
197:   var z = res.z || 0;
198:   var mag = Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z);
199:   var now = Date.now();
200: 
201:   // 1. Update gravity estimate (EMA)
202:   if (_gravity === 0) {
203:     _gravity = mag;
204:   } else {
205:     _gravity = GRAVITY_EMA_ALPHA * _gravity + (1 - GRAVITY_EMA_ALPHA) * mag;
206:   }
207: 
208:   // 2. Linear acceleration = total minus gravity
209:   var linear = Math.abs(mag - _gravity);
210: 
211:   // 3. Peak detection state machine
212:   switch (_peakState) {
213:     case PEAK_IDLE:
214:       if (linear > PUNCH_LINEAR_THRESHOLD) {
215:         _peakState = PEAK_RISING;
216:         _peakValue = linear;
217:         _peakStartTime = now;
218:       }
219:       break;
220: 
221:     case PEAK_RISING:
222:       if (linear > _peakValue) {
223:         _peakValue = linear;
224:       } else {
225:         _peakState = PEAK_HOLDING;
226:         _peakStartTime = now;
227:       }
228:       break;
229: 
230:     case PEAK_HOLDING:
231:       if (linear > _peakValue) {
232:         _peakState = PEAK_RISING;
233:         _peakValue = linear;
234:       } else if (now - _peakStartTime >= PEAK_HOLDBACK_MS) {
235:         if (now - _lastPunchTime >= COOLDOWN_MS) {
236:           _lastPunchTime = now;
237:           var confidence = Math.min(0.95, 0.5 + _peakValue * CONFIDENCE_SCALE);
238:           confidence = Math.max(0.3, confidence);
239:           _punchCallback({
240:             type: 'other',
241:             hand: 'unknown',
242:             confidence: Math.round(confidence * 100) / 100,
243:             timestamp: now
244:           });
245:         }
246:         _peakState = PEAK_COOLDOWN;
247:         _peakStartTime = now;
248:       }
249:       break;
250: 
251:     case PEAK_COOLDOWN:
252:       if (now - _peakStartTime >= COOLDOWN_MS) {
253:         _peakState = PEAK_IDLE;
254:         _peakValue = 0;
255:       }
256:       break;
257:   }
258: }

261:  * Stop receiving punch events.
262:  */
263: function unsubscribePunches() {
264:   if (_replayTimer) {

266:     _replayTimer = null;
267:   }
268:   try {

271:     }
272:   } catch (e) {

274:   }
275:   _punchCallback = null;
276:   _errorCallback = null;
277:   _resetPeakState();
278: }

284:  * @param {number} speed — playback speed multiplier
285:  */
286: function replayDemoEvents(onEvent, speed) {
287:   var events = demoData.demoEvents;
288:   var idx = 0;
289: 
290:   function playNext() {
291:     if (idx >= events.length) {
292:       return;
293:     }
294:     var evt = events[idx];
295:     var delay = idx === 0 ? evt.offsetMs : (events[idx].offsetMs - events[idx - 1].offsetMs);
296:     delay = Math.round(delay / speed);
297: 
298:     _replayTimer = setTimeout(function () {
299:       if (_punchCallback) {
300:         _punchCallback({
301:           type: evt.type,
302:           hand: evt.hand,
303:           confidence: evt.confidence,
304:           timestamp: Date.now()
305:         });
306:       }
307:       idx++;
308:       playNext();
309:     }, delay);
310:   }
311: 
312:   playNext();
313: }
